sentence: Chatterjee et al. ask about rivals directly: one of their competitive-advantage items states that implementing AI-based customer relationship management "will help an organization to win over its competitor which has not yet implemented AI-CRM"
passage: [Chatterjee et al. (2021), p. 215] "I think that successful implementation of AI-CRM will help an organization to win over its competitor which has not yet implemented AI-CRM for B2B relationship management."

gemini.note: By omitting 'I think that' and misquoting the item to remove the 'for B2B relationship management' context, the sentence presents the claim as more declarative and broader than the original.
